writing.title: Writing Autocomplete & Rewrite
writing.desc: Configure a dedicated completion/rewrite model (OpenAI-compatible endpoint) for the writing workspace. Get ghost-text suggestions while typing, and rewrite a selection in place with ⌘K. Independent of the chat agent and daily report models.
writing.configuredHint: Configured: autocomplete and ⌘K rewrite are enabled.
writing.notConfiguredHint: Not configured yet: fill in the endpoint and model below to enable autocomplete and ⌘K rewrite.
writing.completionDesc: After a pause while typing, show a ghost-text suggestion. Tab to accept; Esc or keep typing to dismiss.
writing.retrievalDesc: Before generating suggestions and assistant replies, quickly reference other Markdown docs in the writing space to keep terms, facts, and style consistent.
writing.inlineEditDesc: Select text and press ⌘K to enter a rewrite instruction; the result goes through the red/green diff review before saving. Available once a model is configured.
writing.imageGenNote: The image model used for generating infographics in writing is configured under Settings → Media Generation → Image Generation.
writing.quickActionsDesc: Quick actions available when text is selected, also shown as assistant empty-state cards. Built-in actions can be disabled but not deleted; up to 12 custom actions can be added.
writing.quickActionsCap: Up to 12 custom actions; limit reached
writing.fontPresetDesc: Body font for the writing area; pick one suited to long-form Chinese reading.
writing.fontSizeDesc: Body font size (10–48px) for the editor and preview; same source as the toolbar stepper.
writing.lineHeightDesc: Body line height; larger means more space between lines (1.4–2.2).
writing.typographyResetDesc: Restore the default font, size and line height.
writing.advancedDesc: Trigger cadence and suggestion length; defaults suit most cases.
writing.debounceDesc: How long after you stop typing before a suggestion appears.
writing.maxTokensDesc: Larger means longer suggestions (16–512 tokens). Keep it short.
writing.debugLogDesc: Recent autocomplete / ⌘K rewrite calls (metadata only, no content) for troubleshooting model responsiveness, latency and errors. Cleared on process restart.
writing.debugLogEmpty: No entries yet (visible after one autocomplete or ⌘K rewrite).

archivedSessions.title: Archived conversations
archivedSessions.subtitle: Archived conversation history
archivedSessions.desc: View conversations removed from the active sidebar. You can open, restore, or permanently delete them here.

browser.title: Browser
browser.desc: Manage the built-in browser and the agent's browser-control permission.
browser.enableLabel: Allow agents to control the built-in browser
browser.enableDesc: When on, claude / codex gain the browser-control tools: navigate, click, fill, screenshot, read DOM and console in the built-in browser you are viewing. Local URLs (localhost / 127.0.0.1) skip approval; non-local URLs need pre-authorization under Site permissions below. If the project already has your own .mcp.json, claude is not auto-injected (add it manually; codex is unaffected).
browser.localUrlDesc: Where localhost / 127.0.0.1 links open by default
browser.localUrlHint: Only affects localhost / 127.0.0.1 links; external links always open in the built-in browser.
browser.clearDataDesc: Clear website data and cache in the in-app browser
browser.clearDataConfirm: This clears history, cookies and cache and cannot be undone. Clear now?
browser.screenshotDesc: Whether to attach the current page screenshot when sending annotations to Chat
browser.screenshotHint: In this version, "Ask" means manual attach (a send-time prompt will come later).
browser.approvalDesc: Choose the pre-authorization scope before agents open sites. cortex uses a pre-authorization allowlist (not a just-in-time prompt).
browser.approvalHint: With "Allow all", agents can open any site (including intranet) without an allowlist. After switching to "including localhost", add localhost under Site permissions below first, otherwise local navigation is denied.
browser.approvalNonLocal: Only external sites need pre-authorization · localhost free
browser.approvalAll: All sites need pre-authorization · including localhost
browser.sitesDesc: Override the defaults above for specific sites
browser.sitesInvalid: Enter a full origin, e.g. https://example.com
browser.sitesDuplicate: This site is already in the list
browser.sitesPendingDesc: Sites an agent was denied; add to allow next time.
browser.cdpDesc: Allow agents to use full Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) access: observe all network requests (sensitive headers redacted in display) and the accessibility tree, and occupy the debugger (mutually exclusive with DevTools).
browser.cdpConfirm: When on, agents can observe all network requests and the accessibility tree and occupy the debugger. Enable?

profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: Set your nickname and avatar; messages you send in conversations will use them.
profile.nicknameDesc: The name shown on messages you send in conversations.

pet.title: Desktop pet
pet.desc: Pick a companion to keep you company; it switches animations based on typing, thinking, tool execution and more.
pet.offlineNote: You are offline; showing the last cached catalog.

general.title: General
general.desc: Manage interface preferences, the default working directory and desktop behavior.
general.themeDesc: Light, dark or follow the system.
general.fontSizeDesc: Adjust the overall interface text size.
general.workspaceRootDesc: Where the agent runs for new project-less conversations / scheduled tasks without a project (leave empty to use the home directory).
general.globalInstructionDesc: Custom instruction applied uniformly to all agents (claude / codex / pi), injected into the system prompt every turn. Distinct from "pi System Prompt (pi only)". Takes effect on your next send.
general.globalInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. Always answer concisely, and outline your approach before showing code.
general.openAtLoginDesc: Start Cortex automatically after you log in (macOS / Windows).
general.startMinimizedDesc: Minimize to the background after launch (mainly for Windows).
general.closeToTrayDesc: Hide to the system tray when the window is closed instead of quitting the app.
general.notesHotkeyDesc: Global hotkey to summon quick notes. Click and press a new combination to record; if it's taken you'll be notified and the old key kept.
general.notesHotkeyFailed: Failed to set hotkey; original hotkey kept
general.turnCompleteDesc: Show a system notification when an agent turn ends and the window is unfocused.
general.currentVersionDesc: Check for new versions available in GitHub Releases.
general.logEnabledDesc: Write main-process logs to a local file to help with troubleshooting.
general.logRetentionDesc: Old logs beyond the retention period are cleaned automatically on startup.

providers.title: Providers
providers.catalogUnavailable: Model catalog unavailable: {{error}}. The catalog ships with the app, so restarting usually fixes it; until then you cannot sign in to providers or inspect model capabilities.
providers.catalogEmpty: The model catalog contains no usable providers.
providers.storageUnavailable: The system keychain is unavailable ({{reason}}): provider settings are read-only, and keys cannot be added or changed. Cortex will never write keys back in plaintext — fix the keychain and everything resumes.
providers.legacyCleared: Provider configuration has been upgraded. The old providers and their plaintext keys were removed; please sign in again to the providers you use.

statusHint.none: No credentials yet — this provider will not appear in model pickers.
statusHint.safeStorage: The API key is encrypted by the system keychain and can be removed at any time.
statusHint.env: Credentials come from environment variable {{vars}}, provided by the shell that launched Cortex.
statusHint.ambient: Credentials come from the system environment (AWS profile, gcloud ADC, …), provided by the OS or a cloud SDK.

providers.expiresAt: The token expires at {{time}} and refreshes automatically.
providers.apiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved key
providers.apiKeyNeverShown: Keys are never echoed back — Cortex keeps only an encrypted copy, and the UI can never read the plaintext.
providers.ambientReadOnly: These credentials come from the system environment ({{source}}). Cortex can read them but not delete them — remove them from that environment instead.
providers.authNoMethod: This provider needs no sign-in (local endpoint).
providers.connectionTestCostTitle: A connection test makes a real model call
providers.connectionTestCostBody: This sends a minimal request with {{model}} to verify connectivity and **may incur a small charge**. Saving a configuration never tests automatically.
providers.baseUrlOverridePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the official endpoint
providers.baseUrlOverrideUnavailable: Base URL override is unavailable in this environment (web build or an older shell).

models.title: Models · {{count}}
models.readOnly: Model capabilities (image input / reasoning / context / max output / protocol / cost) come from Pi's built-in catalog. They are system metadata and cannot be edited — hand-entered capabilities are exactly what caused images to be silently dropped.
models.sourceTitle: Where these capability values came from

custom.title: Custom providers
custom.hint: Paste a complete Pi provider JSON (including the models array with input / reasoning / contextWindow / maxTokens for each model). Cortex guesses nothing — a missing field means an incomplete configuration and the save is rejected.
custom.validateUnavailable: Provider JSON cannot be validated in this environment.
custom.secretsHint: Sensitive headers must be written as ${secret:NAME} references; the plaintext lives only in the system keychain. Inline plaintext keys in the JSON are rejected.
custom.undefinedRefs: These secrets are referenced but not defined: {{names}}
custom.inlineSecret: The JSON appears to embed a plaintext secret ({{field}}). Replace it with a ${secret:NAME} reference before saving.

auth.title: Sign in to {{provider}}
auth.authUrlHint: Finish authorization in the browser, then come back here.
auth.deviceCodeHint: Enter this device code in the browser:
auth.manualCodeHint: Paste the authorization code from the browser callback URL here.
auth.unavailable: This environment does not support the provider's sign-in flow.

picker.title: Select a model
picker.empty: No models available yet. Sign in to a provider in the provider manager first.
picker.emptyImage: No available model supports image input. Sign in to a multimodal provider.
picker.dangling: The current configuration points at {{provider}} · {{model}}, which is missing from the catalog or not signed in. Pick another one — Cortex will not silently fall back to a different model.
picker.requireImageHint: Only models that accept image input are listed.

inline.subsDesc: One-click OAuth, no API key needed
inline.keysDesc: Paste to use · never echoed back after saving
inline.cloudDesc: Credentials mostly come from env vars or cloud SDKs (region / account / ADC…); Cortex only manages the API key
inline.gatewayDesc: OpenAI-compatible gateways such as new-api / one-api: one endpoint brings in a whole batch of models, capabilities resolved by the system
inline.customDesc: Ollama / LM Studio / vLLM or any compatible endpoint — paste a complete Pi provider JSON
inline.addCustom: ＋ Add a custom provider (written to provider-custom.json)
inline.chatReady: Available in the chat model picker ({{count}} models)
inline.chatUnusableParse: Incomplete configuration: the provider JSON cannot be parsed, so its models will not show up in the chat model picker. Open “Edit” and hit “Validate” to locate the error.
inline.chatUnusableModels: Incomplete configuration: no model passed validation, so nothing will show up in the chat model picker. Every model must spell out input / reasoning / contextWindow / maxTokens.
inline.defaultModelHint: Only models from configured providers are listed — {{count}} providers available. Connect providers right below on this page.

form.title: New custom provider
form.name: Name
form.capsDesc: Applies to every model listed above; Cortex guesses nothing — missing values are rejected
form.keyStored: The API key is stored in the system keychain as secret “{{name}}” — the JSON keeps only a reference, never the plaintext.
form.secretFailed: Failed to store the secret in the system keychain
form.savedHint: Saved to provider-custom.json and appears in the default-model candidates

gateway.title: Connect an aggregation gateway
gateway.desc: OpenAI-compatible gateways such as new-api / one-api: enter the endpoint and the model list is fetched for you — capabilities are resolved by the system, nothing to type by hand
gateway.editDesc: Change the name, endpoint or key, or add and remove enabled models. Capabilities are still resolved by the system — nothing to type by hand
gateway.editSeedHint: These are the models saved in this configuration. If the gateway added or retired models, hit “Refresh model list” to probe it again.
gateway.keyKeep: already saved — leave blank to keep
gateway.keyKeepPh: Leave blank to keep the saved key, or type a new one to replace it
gateway.unsupported: Aggregation gateways are not supported in this environment (web build or an older shell).
gateway.name: Name
gateway.keyPh: Fill in if the gateway requires authentication
gateway.keyStored: The API key is stored in the system keychain as secret “{{name}}” — the configuration keeps only a reference, never the plaintext.
gateway.secretFailed: Failed to store the secret in the system keychain
gateway.discoverFailed: Could not reach the gateway: {{error}}. Check the endpoint and API key, then try again — a configuration that fails discovery is never saved.
gateway.capsReadonly: Capabilities are resolved from the built-in model catalog and are read-only — Cortex never guesses a capability field
gateway.empty: The gateway returned no models. Make sure the endpoint points at /v1 and that the key has access.
gateway.referenceMore: {{count}} more — keep typing to narrow it down
gateway.missingWarn: These enabled models did not show up in the latest refresh: {{names}}. They are still saved — check whether the gateway retired them.
gateway.missingRow: The gateway did not return this model in the latest refresh.
gateway.buildFailed: Could not generate the provider configuration: {{error}}
gateway.fallbackHint: Not in the bundled catalog — using conservative defaults (text-only). Usable as is.
gateway.refineReference: Pick a reference model for exact capabilities

agent.title: Agent
agent.desc: Cortex supports three agents: Claude Code, Codex and the built-in Cortex. Claude / Codex use their own CLI auth; the built-in Cortex ships with the app and is always available, using the providers you configure under Models. Providers and the default model live in the Models section.
agent.defaultDesc: Used as the default for new sessions, and to generate the home greeting. Falls back automatically when the chosen agent is unavailable.

subagents.title: Sub-agents
subagents.desc: Manage delegated sub-agent runtime policy, models, reasoning effort, prompts, and capabilities in one place. These settings stay in sync with the workspace sub-agent panel.

pi.title: Models
pi.desc: Connect model providers and pick the default model here, for use by the built-in Cortex agent. Everything happens on this page and saves as you go, taking effect on a new session or your next send.
pi.defaultProviderDesc: Used by default for new Cortex sessions.

computerUse.piOnly: This setting applies to the built-in Cortex agent only: computer use is powered by its native extension and loads only in Cortex sessions — it has no effect on Claude Code / Codex.
computerUse.enabledDesc: Lets Cortex see the screen, move the mouse and press keys to operate apps on this machine. Every state-changing action (click / type / drag / hotkey / clipboard write) asks for your confirmation first. Takes effect on your next message (restarts the current Cortex session).
computerUse.statusDesc: All five conditions must hold before the computer-use tools are handed to Cortex. If any is missing the whole toolset is withheld, rather than handing over tools that are guaranteed to fail.
computerUse.grantFailed: Couldn't open System Settings. Please grant access manually under System Settings › Privacy & Security.
computerUse.grantUnavailable: Jumping to the permission pane isn't available here. Please open System Settings › Privacy & Security manually.
computerUse.grantHint: If the app still isn't in the list after re-requesting: reveal it in Finder here and drag it into the permission list — no need to hunt for the path yourself.
computerUse.installFailed: Install failed. Check your network connection and retry.
computerUse.groundingModelDesc: Actions like click and type first take a screenshot, then ask a vision-capable model where the target element is. Leave empty to use the session model — but if that model isn't marked as supporting image input, these actions will fail outright. The model must belong to the provider the session uses (only the one provider selected for the session is loaded).
computerUse.noVisionModel: No vision-capable model available yet. In Provider Management, tick "supports image input" on a model that accepts images and it will show up here.
computerUse.learnNotice: Note: this capability ships a /learn command that records one manual demonstration and turns it into a skill. While recording it captures global keystrokes and the full screen (including what you type in other apps) and sends them to the model, and it is not covered by the tool-approval or plan-mode restrictions above. Use it only when nothing sensitive is on screen.
computerUse.stateNotInstalled: Component not installed (needs a one-time download)
computerUse.stateNoSwiftc: Xcode Command Line Tools missing — run xcode-select --install
computerUse.grantConfirmDesc: This resets this app's record for that permission so macOS shows its authorization prompt again (otherwise the prompt appears only once, after which the app is no longer added to the list automatically). macOS may restart this app as a result.
computerUse.revealFailed: Couldn't reveal the app in Finder.

push.title: Push channels
push.desc: Global push configuration; once enabled it can be used by any feature that supports push.
push.formatHint: Pin the push format with a .md template from the Prompt library; the first rendered line becomes the push title. Placeholders: {{placeholders}}; placeholder lines with empty data are hidden automatically.
push.exampleSkillDesc: Select a directory in the Prompt library on the right first.
push.internalDesc: Show a system notification when automation finishes — works even when the window is closed or minimized.
push.feishuSecretDesc: Optional; fill in when the security setting is "Signature".
push.dingtalkSecretDesc: Optional; fill in when the security setting is "Signature".
push.fromPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the account

voice.title: Voice (TTS)
voice.desc: Convert agent / LLM output into speech. With auto-read on, each turn is read aloud when it completes (code blocks and the like are skipped; a new reply interrupts the previous one).
voice.autoSpeakDesc: Read aloud when each turn completes (code blocks skipped; a new reply interrupts the previous one).
voice.voiceSystemDesc: Uses the local system voice library; no network or configuration needed.
voice.voiceEdgeDesc: Provided by Microsoft and requires a network connection; falls back to the system voice when unavailable.
voice.showAllLocalesDesc: Only Chinese voices are listed by default; turn this on to show every language Microsoft offers.
voice.baseUrlDesc: OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech (OpenAI TTS / LocalAI / Kokoro and other local deployments all work).
voice.testFailed: Preview failed. Check your network and try again.
voice.testText: Hello, this is a voice test for Cortex Desktop.

mediaGen.title: Media Generation
mediaGen.desc: Configure image, speech, music and video generation as Agent-callable tools. When enabled, generate_image, generate_speech, generate_music and generate_video are registered per your settings.
mediaGen.overviewDesc: When enabled, agents can call the corresponding media generation tools in conversations. Each modality can be enabled independently with its own provider or custom API.
mediaGen.providerDesc: Select a configured provider, or use a custom API.
mediaGen.providerKeyManagedHint: Using {{name}}'s API key (configured in Provider settings)
mediaGen.providerNotConfigured: "{{name}}" has no API key configured yet; media generation calls will fail.
mediaGen.providerOauthUnsupported: Media generation does not support OAuth credentials yet. Please configure an API key in Provider settings.
mediaGen.apiKeyUnsupported: The credential vault is not available in this environment. Please configure it in the desktop app.

image.enableDesc: Enable the generate_image tool in Agent chats and for infographic generation in Writing. MiniMax can reuse the provider key; custom OpenAI-compatible image APIs are still supported.
image.providerDesc: Pick a provider with an image model configured, or use a custom image API.
image.protocolDesc: Request format used by the custom image API.
image.baseUrlDesc: Root URL of the OpenAI-compatible service; the tool requests {baseUrl}/images/generations.
image.apiKeyDesc: Key for the image service, independent from chat model keys.
image.modelDesc: Model name sent to the provider, e.g. gpt-image-1 or Kwai-Kolors/Kolors.
image.modelQualityHint: Prefer GPT Image or Gemini image models. Domestic image models are still unstable for layout- and text-accuracy-sensitive cases like design drafts and infographics.
image.qualityDesc: Quality hint sent to APIs that support it, independent from output resolution. Higher quality usually means more detail but slower and pricier.
image.resolutionDesc: Used when the assistant does not specify a resolution; Auto lets the provider decide. Available tiers depend on provider and model.
image.defaultSizeDesc: Advanced override, "WxH". Priority: assistant-specified > custom default size > default resolution. Leave empty to use the default resolution above.
image.timeoutDesc: Timeout for a single image request. High-resolution output may take minutes.

speech.enableDesc: Enable the generate_speech tool in Agent chats to turn text into audio files.
speech.providerDesc: Pick a provider with a TTS model configured, or use a custom speech API.
speech.protocolDesc: Request format used by the custom speech API.
speech.baseUrlDesc: Root URL of the speech service, e.g. https://api.minimax.io or https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1.
speech.apiKeyDesc: Key for the speech service, independent from chat model keys.
speech.modelDesc: Model name sent to the provider, e.g. speech-2.8-hd or mimo-v2.5-tts.
speech.voiceDesc: Optional voice ID or name. MiniMax defaults to male-qn-qingse; Xiaomi accepts official voice values.
speech.formatDesc: Default format of generated audio files.
speech.timeoutDesc: Timeout for a single speech request.

music.enableDesc: Enable the generate_music tool in Agent chats to create songs, instrumentals or covers.
music.providerDesc: Pick a provider with a music model configured, or use a custom music API.
music.protocolDesc: Request format used by the custom music API.
music.baseUrlDesc: Root URL of the music service, e.g. https://api.minimax.io.
music.apiKeyDesc: Key for the music service, independent from chat model keys.
music.modelDesc: Model name sent to the provider, e.g. music-2.6 or music-cover.
music.formatDesc: Default format of generated music files.
music.timeoutDesc: Timeout for a single music request.

video.enableDesc: Enable the generate_video tool in Agent chats, with text-to-video and first/last frame references.
video.providerDesc: Pick a provider with a video model configured, or use a custom video API.
video.protocolDesc: Request format used by the custom video API.
video.baseUrlDesc: Root URL of the video service, e.g. https://api.minimax.io.
video.apiKeyDesc: Key for the video service, independent from chat model keys.
video.modelDesc: Model name sent to the provider, e.g. MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3.
video.durationDesc: Used when the Agent does not specify a duration.
video.resolutionDesc: Used when the Agent does not specify a resolution.
video.timeoutDesc: Total wait time for a single video task.
video.pollIntervalDesc: Interval for polling async video task status.

stt.title: Speech to Text
stt.desc: Configure speech recognition with local SenseVoiceSmall or cloud APIs.
stt.enableDesc: When enabled, you can record audio via the microphone icon in the input box and convert it to text.
stt.providerDesc: Choose local SenseVoiceSmall, a configured provider, or a custom API.
stt.downloadSourceDesc: Choose where to download the pinned SenseVoiceSmall GGUF model.
stt.sourceUnavailableHint: This source is unreachable. Please switch source or check your network.
stt.modelsDesc: Download or delete SenseVoiceSmall Q8. Local audio never leaves this device.
stt.languageDesc: Specifying a language improves speed; auto-detect works well for mixed-language content.
stt.timeoutDesc: Timeout for a single transcription request in milliseconds. Default 60000.

speech.title: Voice
speech.desc: Manage your microphone, voice assistant, system dictation, and speech-recognition models.
speech.microphoneDesc: Choose the input device used by voice chat and dictation.
speech.chatHotkeyDesc: Summon the voice orb from any app (shares the pet window; the pet hides).
speech.chatScreenContextDesc: Send a screenshot of the frontmost app so the Agent can understand what you are viewing.
speech.dictationHoldHotkeyDesc: Hold to record, then release to transcribe and insert at the current cursor. Requires Accessibility permission.
speech.dictationToggleHotkeyDesc: Press once to record, then again to transcribe and insert.
speech.dictationBarAlwaysVisibleDesc: Keep the bottom-screen hotkey reminder visible while idle.
speech.hotkeyFailed: Voice hotkeys were not applied. Previous settings were restored.
speech.dictionaryRowDesc: Bias recognition toward proper nouns; it never replaces your spoken content.
speech.dictionaryDesc: Add names, product terms, or abbreviations for online prompting and local transcript correction.
speech.modelsDesc: Configure local SenseVoiceSmall or a cloud speech-recognition service.
speech.polishEnableDesc: After transcription, use an LLM to fix homophones, typos and punctuation; skipped automatically when no model is available
speech.polishModelHint: Pick a fast, small model; leave unset to follow the global default model
speech.polishPromptDesc: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt. The dictation dictionary and transcript are appended automatically
speech.chatPromptDesc: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt (conversational tone, no markdown, TTS-friendly). The transcript is appended automatically
speech.intentModeDesc: Function calling reuses the current Agent's tools with the lowest latency; classifier mode first detects local voice-assistant controls
speech.intentModelHint: Pick a fast, small model; leave unset to follow the global default model
speech.commandFuzzyMatchDesc: Pinyin-tolerant matching for short control commands, so homophone mis-transcriptions still trigger locally; questions and long sentences are unaffected
speech.chatStreamTtsDesc: Speak replies sentence by sentence while they are being generated; turn off to wait for the full reply before speaking
speech.wakeWordDesc: Say the wake word to summon the voice assistant without a hotkey. While enabled, the microphone is analyzed continuously in local memory only — audio is never stored or uploaded
speech.wakeWordSensitivityDesc: Higher sensitivity wakes more easily but is more prone to false triggers from ambient sound

roles.title: Role Management
roles.desc: Create and manage custom roles. Use @rolename in chat to invoke the bound Agent with a custom persona.
roles.empty: No custom roles yet. Click above to create one.
roles.promptPlaceholder: Describe this role's capabilities, style, and constraints…

reply.title: Quick Reply
reply.desc: Draft replies in any app with a hotkey — capture the conversation, generate candidates via your selected model provider, and write back without stealing focus. macOS only.
reply.modelDesc: Quick Reply uses the selected model to generate candidates. If it becomes unavailable, you will be asked to choose again instead of switching automatically.
reply.draftTriggerDesc: Double-tap this modifier in any app to start drafting.
reply.voiceTriggerDesc: Hold this key to speak your intent, release to draft.
reply.permissionsDesc: Quick Reply needs these macOS permissions to read conversations and write back.
reply.permissionsFoot: Missing permissions block the corresponding capability. Adjust anytime in System Settings › Privacy & Security.
reply.memoryDesc: Handwritten notes take top priority when drafting. Auto rules are distilled from your own messages.
reply.manualPlaceholder: e.g. I'm the PM for project X; keep replies short and skip greetings.
reply.learningLabel: Learn tone from my sent messages
reply.learningDesc: When on, your outgoing messages are distilled into style rules and per-contact conversation memory.
reply.historyDesc: When on, accepted replies are archived locally with their conversation and candidates. Clearable anytime.
reply.memoryFilesDesc: Memory and reply history are plain local files.
reply.relearnDone: Tone rules rebuilt from reply history.
reply.relearnNoHistory: No reply history to learn from yet.
reply.relearnNoModel: No generation model configured — pick one above first.
reply.channelsDesc: Connect messaging accounts to read real history. Tokens are encrypted and stored locally.
reply.cleanupDesc: Clear stored data. Handwritten notes, learned rules and channel notes can be removed independently.
reply.dataSummary: Stored locally: {{history}} reply history entries · {{conversations}} conversation memories
reply.clearHistoryDesc: Removes locally archived accepted replies (with conversation text and candidates).
reply.clearConversationsDesc: Removes per-contact preference notes and recent replies.
reply.clearMemoryDesc: Removes handwritten notes, learned rules and channel notes.
reply.clearAutoRulesDesc: Removes only the auto-distilled writing rules.
reply.debugDesc: Last 20 calls (in memory only, cleared on quit).

design.title: Design
design.desc: Design workspace: design-to-code, canvas defaults and design-system preferences.
design.stackHintDesc: Hint for "implement in code". Empty = auto-detect from the project.
design.injectIntoCode: Code agent follows the design system
design.injectIntoCodeDesc: Reference the published design system when implementing.
design.publishDesignSystemDesc: Write the design system into the workspace when implementing.
design.liveRefreshDesc: Reload the HTML canvas while generating.
design.deviceFrameDesc: Wrap app-viewport previews in a phone frame.
design.workspaceRootDesc: Where design artifacts are saved. Empty = default (Documents/cortex/design).
design.brandColorDesc: Anchor color (CSS value) injected into the design agent context.
design.toneDesc: Comma separated, e.g. professional, techy, editorial.
design.guidelinesDesc: Injected alongside the preset and written to DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.
design.modelDesc: Empty = follow the current workspace model.
design.generationPromptDesc: Override the built-in single-file HTML rules. Empty = default.

memory.title: Memory
memory.desc: Persistent user memory shared across chat, writing, and design. In the background it replays recent conversations like dreaming — distilling stable facts and preferences, forgetting stale ones. Memory is injected into every AI turn.
memory.enabledDesc: When off, nothing is injected and background consolidation stops.
memory.contentDesc: Handwritten notes have the highest priority; the auto section is maintained by the dream pipeline and can be edited. Files live on this machine and can be edited directly.
memory.manualPlaceholder: Write what the AI should always remember, e.g. I'm a frontend engineer, projects use pnpm…
memory.autoEmpty: No consolidated memory yet. Chat for a while, then hit "Consolidate now" or wait for the background run.
memory.lastDreamAt: Last run: {{time}}. Runs automatically when chats go idle and nightly.
memory.neverDreamed: Never run yet. Runs automatically when chats go idle and nightly; you can also trigger it manually.
memory.dreamNothingNew: No new conversation content to consolidate.
memory.dreamInFlight: A run is already in progress; it will finish on its own.
memory.dreamDisabled: Memory is switched off — enable it and retry.
memory.dreamNoModel: No generation model configured. Set one up under "Providers" first.
memory.dataFilesDesc: Each section is a markdown file stored on this machine — view and edit directly.
memory.clearDesc: "Clear auto" keeps handwritten notes; "Clear all" resets to the initial template.
memory.clearAutoConfirm: Clear all auto-consolidated memory? Handwritten notes are kept.
memory.clearAllConfirm: Clear ALL memory? Handwritten notes will be removed too. This cannot be undone.
